title: Apply for the Fertility Treatment Rebate-2
summary: This page provides information on how to apply for the $2,000 Fertility Treatment Rebate-2 to help cover costs for IVF and other Assisted Reproductive Technology (ART) treatments.
intro:
The Fertility Treatment Rebate-2 is designed to help with the costs of IVF and other Assisted Reproductive Technology (ART) treatments.

Eligible women in NSW who have received an eligible fertility treatment on or after 19 February 2025, can apply for the $2,000 rebate.

Note: You must apply within 90 days of the date you received the ART treatment.
who_can_apply: Must be a resident of NSW.
Must have incurred eligible costs for fertility treatment(s) received on or after 19 February 2025.
Must meet one of the specified household income eligibility criteria.
Must be a woman who received the treatment.
Must apply within 90 days of the date the ART treatment was received.

The treatment must be from an eligible ART provider, which may include: treatments from 1 October 2022 to 18 February 2025, treatment at a publicly supported lower cost IVF clinic (NSW Affordable IVF Program), or treatment for fertility preservation.
what_you_need: The Fertility Treatment Rebate-2 Declaration Form – PDF, completed by both the provider and yourself.
Proof of your residential address in NSW.
Proof of payment of treatment(s), showing the costs.
Your bank account details (required for payment if the rebate application is successful).

how_to_steps.text: Gather your supporting documents.Note: If you need help, see our guide for How to upload documents for an online application.
Log in, or create your MyServiceNSW Account.
Follow the prompts to apply for the rebate.

more_info.text: You can only claim the rebate for out-of-pocket costs after you have made any Medicare claims.
If you received the Pre-IVF Fertility Testing Rebate, you can still apply for the Fertility Treatment Rebate-2.
The rebate is available until 30 August 2028, or until the available funds are exhausted.
Check the list of current registered ART providers in NSW.

faqs.q: Who is eligible to apply for the rebate?
faqs.a: You must be a resident of NSW, have received eligible fertility treatment on or after 19 February 2025, and meet specific household income criteria. You must also apply within 90 days of receiving the ART treatment.

faqs.q: What costs can I claim for the rebate?
faqs.a: You can claim the full $2,000 rebate, even if your eligible costs are less than $2,000. You cannot claim out-of-pocket costs that have already been reimbursed by another government program or rebate.

faqs.q: What documents do I need to apply?
faqs.a: You need a MyServiceNSW Account, the completed Fertility Treatment Rebate-2 Declaration Form, proof of your residential address in NSW, proof of eligibility, and your bank account details.
